transcript.text: Good morning. How can I help you today?
transcript.vn: Chao buoi sang. Toi co the giup gi cho ban?

transcript.text: I've been having headaches for the past week.
transcript.vn: Toi bi dau dau ca tuan qua.

transcript.text: Can you describe the pain? Is it sharp or dull?
transcript.vn: Ban mo ta con dau duoc khong? Dau nhoi hay dau am?

transcript.text: It's a dull pain, mostly in the front of my head.
transcript.vn: Dau am am, chu yeu o phia truoc dau.

transcript.text: How often do you get these headaches?
transcript.vn: Ban bi dau dau thuong xuyen khong?

transcript.text: Almost every day, usually in the afternoon.
transcript.vn: Gan nhu moi ngay, thuong vao buoi chieu.

transcript.text: Are you drinking enough water? Dehydration can cause headaches.
transcript.vn: Ban co uong du nuoc khong? Mat nuoc co the gay dau dau.

transcript.text: I probably don't drink enough. I'll try to drink more.
transcript.vn: Co le toi khong uong du. Toi se co uong nhieu hon.

quiz.question: What is the patient's main complaint?
How often does the patient get headaches?
What might be causing the headaches?

transcript.text: Good evening. Welcome to The Garden. Do you have a reservation?
transcript.vn: Chao buoi toi. Chao mung den The Garden. Ban co dat ban truoc khong?

transcript.text: Yes, under the name Wilson. A table for two, please.
transcript.vn: Co, ten Wilson. Ban cho hai nguoi.

transcript.text: Right this way. Here are your menus.
transcript.vn: Moi di theo toi. Day la thuc don.

transcript.text: Thank you. Could we have a few minutes to decide?
transcript.vn: Cam on. Cho chung toi vai phut de chon nhe?

transcript.text: Of course. Would you like something to drink while you wait?
transcript.vn: Duoc a. Ban muon uong gi trong luc cho?

transcript.text: I'll have a glass of water, please. And she'll have an orange juice.
transcript.vn: Cho toi mot ly nuoc. Va co ay uong nuoc cam.

transcript.text: Are you ready to order? What would you like?
transcript.vn: Ban san sang goi mon chua? Ban muon gi?

transcript.text: I'd like the grilled salmon with vegetables, please.
transcript.vn: Cho toi ca hoi nuong voi rau.

transcript.text: Excellent choice. And for dessert?
transcript.vn: Lua chon tuyet voi. Con trang mieng?

transcript.text: We'll decide later, thank you.
transcript.vn: Chung toi se chon sau, cam on.

quiz.question: 'I'd like' is a polite way to say:

transcript.text: Doctor, I've been feeling unwell for about a week now.
transcript.vn: Bac si, toi thay khong khoe khoang mot tuan nay.

transcript.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Can you tell me more about your symptoms?
transcript.vn: Toi rat tiec. Ban co the noi them ve cac trieu chung khong?

transcript.text: Well, it started with a sore throat, and then I developed a cough.
transcript.vn: Bat dau bang dau hong, roi toi bi ho.

transcript.text: Is the cough productive? I mean, are you coughing up any mucus?
transcript.vn: Ho co dom khong? Toi muon noi, ban ho co ra chat nhay khong?

transcript.text: Yes, it's thick and yellowish. And I've had a fever on and off.
transcript.vn: Co, dom dac va mau vang. Va toi bi sot luc co luc khong.

transcript.text: Have you taken any medication so far?
transcript.vn: Ban da uong thuoc gi chua?

transcript.text: Just some over-the-counter pain relievers for the fever.
transcript.vn: Chi uong thuoc giam dau khong ke don de ha sot thoi.

transcript.text: I'd like to do a quick examination. Please open your mouth and say 'aah'.
transcript.vn: Toi muon kham nhanh. Vui long ha mieng va noi 'aah'.

transcript.text: Your throat is quite inflamed. I'm going to prescribe antibiotics.
transcript.vn: Hong ban bi viem kha nang. Toi se ke khang sinh.

transcript.text: How long should I take the antibiotics?
transcript.vn: Toi nen uong khang sinh bao lau?

transcript.text: For seven days. Make sure you complete the full course, even if you feel better.
transcript.vn: Bay ngay. Nho uong het lieu, ngay ca khi ban thay tot hon.

quiz.question: How long should the patient take antibiotics?

transcript.text: Good morning, City Medical Center. How may I help you?
transcript.vn: Chao buoi sang, Trung tam Y te Thanh pho. Toi giup gi duoc?

transcript.text: Hello, I'd like to make an appointment with Dr. Smith, please.
transcript.vn: Xin chao, toi muon dat lich hen voi bac si Smith.

transcript.text: Is this for a routine check-up or is it urgent?
transcript.vn: Day la kham dinh ky hay khan cap?

transcript.text: It's not urgent, but I'd like to be seen this week if possible.
transcript.vn: Khong khan cap, nhung toi muon duoc kham tuan nay neu duoc.

transcript.text: Let me check the schedule. Dr. Smith has an opening on Thursday at 2 PM.
transcript.vn: De toi xem lich. Bac si Smith con lich trong vao thu Nam luc 2 gio chieu.

transcript.text: Thursday at 2 PM works for me. Could I get a morning slot instead?
transcript.vn: Thu Nam 2 gio duoc. Co lich buoi sang khong?

transcript.text: We have 10 AM available on Friday. Would that work?
transcript.vn: Chung toi co lich 10 gio sang thu Sau. Duoc khong?

transcript.text: Friday at 10 AM is perfect. Thank you!
transcript.vn: Thu Sau 10 gio sang hoan hao. Cam on!

transcript.text: May I have your name and date of birth, please?
transcript.vn: Cho toi xin ten va ngay sinh cua ban?

transcript.text: It's Tran, T-R-A-N. Date of birth: March 15th, 1985.
transcript.vn: Tran, T-R-A-N. Ngay sinh: 15 thang 3 nam 1985.

transcript.text: Before we begin, I'd like to explain what we're going to do today.
transcript.vn: Truoc khi bat dau, toi muon giai thich hom nay chung ta se lam gi.

transcript.text: We're going to perform a minor procedure to examine your ear more closely.
transcript.vn: Chung toi se thuc hien mot thu thuat nho de kham tai ban ky hon.

transcript.text: First, I'll apply a local anesthetic so you won't feel any pain.
transcript.vn: Dau tien, toi se boi thuoc te tai cho de ban khong thay dau.

transcript.text: Then, I'll use a small instrument called an otoscope to look inside.
transcript.vn: Sau do, toi se dung dung cu nho goi la den soi tai de nhin ben trong.

transcript.text: You might feel some pressure, but it shouldn't be painful.
transcript.vn: Ban co the thay hoi ap luc, nhung se khong dau.

transcript.text: The whole thing should take about 10 to 15 minutes.
transcript.vn: Toan bo qua trinh khoang 10 den 15 phut.

transcript.text: Do you have any questions before we start?
transcript.vn: Ban co cau hoi gi truoc khi chung ta bat dau khong?

transcript.text: Will I be able to hear normally after the procedure?
transcript.vn: Sau thu thuat toi nghe binh thuong duoc khong?

transcript.text: Yes, your hearing should return to normal within a day or two.
transcript.vn: Co, thinh luc cua ban se tro lai binh thuong trong mot hai ngay.

transcript.text: If you experience any discomfort afterward, please don't hesitate to call us.
transcript.vn: Neu ban thay kho chiu sau do, dung ngai goi cho chung toi.

quiz.question: What instrument will the doctor use?
How long will the procedure take?
